name: zephus
description: Local WYSIWYG website editor for Astro sites

scripts.clean: node scripts/dist-tools.mjs clean && node scripts/dist-tools.mjs clean-release
scripts.licenses: npm run licenses:npm && npm run licenses:crawl && npm run licenses:cargo && npm run licenses:bundled
scripts.licenses:strict: npm run compile:renderer && cross-env CRAWL_LICENSES_STRICT=1 npm run licenses:crawl
scripts.compile: node scripts/dist-tools.mjs clean && npm run compile:main && npm run generate:theme-previews && npm run compile:renderer && npm run licenses && node scripts/dist-tools.mjs copy
scripts.tauri:build: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && tauri build -- --locked
scripts.prerelease:prepare: node scripts/release-warning.js && npm run release:preflight && npm run release:licenses
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:main && npm run typecheck:renderer
scripts.r: git fetch origin && git reset --hard && git clean -fd && git switch -C main origin/main && git reset --hard origin/main && git clean -fd && npm run vi && npm run gitprune:force
scripts.u: node scripts/npm-safe-update.mjs && node scripts/cargo-safe-update.mjs --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && node scripts/sync-version.mjs && node scripts/update-metainfo.mjs && npm run check:tauri-alignment
scripts.test:cargo-safe-update: node --test scripts/cargo-safe-update.test.mjs scripts/check-cargo-update-policy.test.mjs scripts/check-rustsec-ignore-policy.test.mjs scripts/generate-cargo-licenses.test.mjs scripts/git-reset.test.mjs scripts/msstore-pack.test.mjs scripts/run-release.test.mjs scripts/npm-dev-audit.test.cjs scripts/release-licenses.test.mjs scripts/release-preflight.test.mjs scripts/release-branch-protection.test.cjs
scripts.lint: eslint src/ scripts/ && npm run lint:comments
scripts.build:win:prepared: npm run build:win:x64:prepared && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:x64:prepared
scripts.build:win:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared
scripts.build:win: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:win:prepared
scripts.build:msstore:win: npm run build:msstore:win:x64 && npm run build:msstore:win:arm64
scripts.build:msstore:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:msstore:win:x64 && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/msstore-pack.mjs x64
scripts.build:msstore:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:msstore:win:arm64 && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/msstore-pack.mjs arm64
scripts.build:msstore: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:msstore:win && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/msstore-pack.mjs
scripts.build:mac:universal: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:mac:universal:prepared
scripts.build:mac:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:mac:arm64:prepared && node scripts/zip-macos.mjs --target aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:mac:x64:prepared && node scripts/zip-macos.mjs --target x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:mac: npm run build:mac:arm64 && npm run build:mac:x64
scripts.build:linux:x64:prepared: dotenv -e .env -v LDAI_COMP=zstd -- tauri build --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles appimage -- --locked
scripts.build:linux:arm64:prepared: dotenv -e .env -v LDAI_COMP=zstd -- tauri build --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --bundles appimage -- --locked
scripts.build:linux:x64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:linux:x64:prepared
scripts.build:linux:arm64: npm run sync-version && npm run licenses && npm run build:linux:arm64:prepared
scripts.workspace:bootstrap: npm run rust:update && npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run sync-version
scripts.release:prepare: npm run workspace:bootstrap && npm run test:all -- --require-clean-proof --skip-e2e --skip-smoke --skip-coverage && npm run dist:clean-release-artifacts
scripts.release:draft: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && dotenv -e .env -- node scripts/ensure-draft-release.cjs
scripts.release:finalize: npm run release:mirror && git fetch origin && git reset --hard @{u} && git clean -fd
scripts.release:win:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:draft && npm run rust:targets:win && npm run build:win:prepared && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:win:x64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:draft && npm run rust:targets:win && npm run build:win:x64:prepared && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:win:arm64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:draft && npm run rust:targets:win && npm run build:win:arm64:prepared && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:win:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:win:continue
scripts.release:win: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs win
scripts.release:mac:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:targets:mac && npm run build:mac:arm64 && npm run build:mac:x64 && npm run build:mac:dmg:ulmo && npm run build:mac:updater-zst && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:mac:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:mac:continue
scripts.release:mac: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs mac
scripts.release:mac:ssh: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && npm run mac:ssh:keychain && npm run release:mac
scripts.release:linux:x64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:target:linux:x64 && npm run build:linux:x64:prepared && node scripts/check-linux-glibc.mjs --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && node scripts/check-appimage-compression.mjs --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu && npm run flatpak:clean && npm run flatpak:bundle && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:linux:arm64:continue: npm run release:session:verify && npm run release:licenses && npm run release:wait-draft && npm run rust:target:linux:arm64 && npm run build:linux:arm64:prepared && node scripts/check-linux-glibc.mjs --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && npm run release:sign:gpg && npm run release:finalize
scripts.release:linux:resume: npm run prerelease:prepare && npm run release:linux:continue
scripts.release:linux:x64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs linux:x64
scripts.release:linux:arm64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs linux:arm64
scripts.release:linux: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs linux
scripts.release:db:win: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs win
scripts.release:db:win:x64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs win:x64
scripts.release:db:win:arm64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs win:arm64
scripts.release:db:mac: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs mac
scripts.release:db:mac:ssh: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && npm run mac:ssh:keychain && npm run release:db:mac
scripts.release:db:linux: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs linux
scripts.release:db:linux:x64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs linux:x64
scripts.release:db:linux:arm64: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && node scripts/run-release.mjs linux:arm64
scripts.release:db:all: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env RELEASE_PIPELINE=1 RELEASE_CHANNEL=db RELEASE_BRANCH=main node scripts/release-gate.js && cross-env RELEASE_BRANCH=main npm run release:draft && npm run release:db:mac && npm run release:db:win && npm run release:db:linux
scripts.flatpak:bundle: node scripts/prepare-flatpak-source.mjs && flatpak-builder --repo=flatpak-repo --force-clean flatpak-build run.rosie.zephus.yml && flatpak build-bundle flatpak-repo dist/Zephus-Linux-x64.flatpak run.rosie.zephus
scripts.flatpak:bundle:arm64: node scripts/prepare-flatpak-source.mjs && flatpak-builder --arch=aarch64 --repo=flatpak-repo --force-clean flatpak-build run.rosie.zephus.yml && flatpak build-bundle flatpak-repo dist/Zephus-Linux-arm64.flatpak run.rosie.zephus
scripts.setup:deb: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential curl wget file libgtk-3-dev libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libjavascriptcoregtk-4.1-dev libsoup-3.0-dev libglib2.0-dev libssl-dev libayatana-appindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev patchelf xdg-utils xvfb 7zip flatpak flatpak-builder && sudo flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flathub https://flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo && sudo flatpak install -y flathub org.gnome.Platform//50 org.gnome.Sdk//50 org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.node24//25.08 org.freedesktop.Sdk.Extension.rust-stable//25.08
